ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; approximately 15% high-intensity white coverage against an 85% low-intensity black background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-contrast white mottling located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; scattered focal white points and small geometric blobs distributed across the central dark surface of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency and irregular serration pattern with significant pixel-amplitude variation (deep and shallow jaggedness) along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe displays a convex outer sweep; the left lobe displays a more irregular, truncated convex trajectory toward the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple roughly circular, high-contrast ring-like clusters (barnacle scars) concentrated on the right lobe and scattered sparsely on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several thin, unaligned white linear streaks (rake-like marks) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion and tearing along the trailing edges of both lobes, combined with numerous circular parasitic or barnacle attachment scars.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge exhibits a uniquely high degree of jaggedness and multiple secondary indentations not associated with the median notch.
